categories.main_business_segments: Jiujiang Shanshui Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of dye intermediates, pesticide intermediates, and pharmaceutical intermediates. Key products include 6-nitro, 5-nitro, chloropyridine series, and amino benzene sulfonic acid derivatives. The company also operates subsidiaries focused on chloropyridine and amino benzene sulfonic acid production and chemical product sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis technologies including continuous nitrification, melting methods, and hydrogenation reduction processes. It holds multiple invention patents and proprietary technologies that improve product yield, purity, and environmental compliance. Production emphasizes green, safe, and efficient processes with innovations such as continuous chloropyridine production and automated hydrogenation for amino benzene sulfonic acid.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves manufacturing customers in the dye, pesticide, and pharmaceutical industries, supplying intermediates used in textile dyeing, agriculture, and medicine. Its products are used domestically across various sectors including textile printing, leather, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals. The customer base includes major dye enterprises with long-term stable relationships, accounting for nearly 70% of sales concentrated among the top five clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily within China, with the company headquartered in the Jishan Industrial Park, Pengze County, Jiangxi Province. There is no significant overseas revenue reported, and all sales are domestic. The company’s subsidiaries are also located in Jiangxi and Zhejiang provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiujiang Shanshui Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, producing chemical intermediates that serve as raw materials for downstream dye, pesticide, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. It procures basic chemical raw materials such as 2-naphthol, sodium nitrite, and pyridine upstream and supplies intermediates downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on green, high-quality, and efficient production processes. R&D efforts target product quality improvement, process automation, and environmental sustainability. It plans to expand production capacity, enhance core technologies, and strengthen collaboration with academic and research institutions to maintain industry-leading R&D capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical intermediates to manufacturing customers. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance of products. It also earns income from related services and occasional investment gains but mainly relies on product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiujiang Shanshui Technology positions itself as a leading domestic producer of dye, pesticide, and pharmaceutical intermediates with strong technical advantages and product quality. It competes in the fine chemical industry, focusing on high-value-added products and green manufacturing. The company maintains a leading market share in its product segments within China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 504.6 million, a 1.88% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 52.95 million, up 151.51%. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.22 billion and equity of RMB 1.93 billion. It has shown steady growth with increased R&D investment and expanding production capacity, though cash flow from operations was negative in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product purity, stable quality, and environmentally friendly production processes as key differentiators. Its products have higher active ingredient content, lower acidity, and better stability compared to industry peers, reducing downstream customer costs. Continuous innovation in production technology reduces waste and environmental impact, supporting sustainable development and compliance with stringent regulations.
